item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Navya facing a plane mirror. She raises her left arm. The dashed figure is the image.

Which claim correctly applies lateral inversion?

options.A: In the image, the raised arm appears on the right side.
options.B: In the image, the raised arm appears to point downward instead of upward.
options.C: Ordinary lettering painted as AMBULANCE on a van would still read as AMBULANCE in a rear-view mirror ahead.
options.D: A photograph of Navya raising her left arm must show her raising her right arm.
